description: Flat record-level metadata schema for a clinical registry of prostate cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy, including demographics, disease characteristics, treatment planning, delivery events, toxicities, and follow-up outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique registry record identifier for this patient-treatment episode; must be stable and non-personally identifying.

patient_id.descr: Pseudonymized patient identifier used to link multiple records for the same individual across registry visits.

age_at_radiotherapy_start_years.descr: Age at start of radiotherapy in years.

sex.descr: Biological sex or recorded sex at diagnosis; expected values include male, female, intersex, or unknown.

ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or clinically recorded ethnicity using local coding standards; example values may include White, Black, Asian, Hispanic/Latino, Mixed, Other, Unknown.

race.descr: Race category if collected separately from ethnicity, using local or national coding standards.

body_mass_index_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index calculated as weight in kg divided by height in meters squared.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at baseline; expected values include never, former, current, unknown.

alcohol_use_status.descr: Alcohol use category at baseline; expected values may include none, occasional, regular, heavy, unknown.

performance_status.descr: Baseline functional status such as ECOG or Karnofsky score; specify the coding system in registry documentation.

comorbidity_burden_score.descr: Summary comorbidity score at baseline, such as Charlson Comorbidity Index or similar.

diabetes_mellitus.descr: Whether the patient has diabetes mellitus at baseline.

hypertension.descr: Whether the patient has hypertension at baseline.

cardiovascular_disease.descr: Whether the patient has documented cardiovascular disease at baseline.

chronic_kidney_disease.descr: Whether the patient has chronic kidney disease at baseline.

baseline_psa_ng_ml.descr: Prostate-specific antigen level before treatment in ng/mL.

clinical_t_stage.descr: Clinical T stage at diagnosis or treatment decision time, e.g., cT1, cT2, cT3, cT4.

clinical_n_stage.descr: Clinical N stage at diagnosis or treatment decision time, e.g., cN0, cN1, cNx.

clinical_m_stage.descr: Clinical M stage at diagnosis or treatment decision time, e.g., cM0, cM1, cMx.

gleason_score.descr: Gleason score or Grade Group representation, as recorded in the registry.

risk_group.descr: Prostate cancer risk group classification, such as low, intermediate, high, very high, metastatic, according to the registry standard.

histology_type.descr: Primary histology type, typically adenocarcinoma for prostate cancer, but capture variants if present.

prior_prostatectomy.descr: Whether the patient had prior prostatectomy before radiotherapy.

prior_androgen_deprivation_therapy.descr: Whether androgen deprivation therapy was given before radiotherapy.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Treatment intent, such as curative, adjuvant, salvage, palliative, or symptom control.

radiotherapy_technique.descr: Radiotherapy delivery technique, such as 3D-CRT, IMRT, VMAT, SBRT, proton therapy, or other.

radiotherapy_modality.descr: Physical modality used, such as photon, proton, electron, or mixed.

treatment_site.descr: Anatomical site treated, such as prostate, prostate bed, pelvic nodes, bone metastasis, or combined fields.

target_volume_name.descr: Name of the planned target volume, for example prostate, prostate bed, seminal vesicles, pelvic lymph nodes.

target_volume_type.descr: Type of target volume, such as GTV, CTV, PTV, nodal_volume, or boost_volume.

target_volume_dose_gy.descr: Prescribed dose to the target volume in Gray.

target_volume_dose_per_fraction_gy.descr: Dose per fraction to the target volume in Gray.

number_of_fractions.descr: Planned number of fractions for the target volume.

fractionation_schedule.descr: Textual or coded fractionation schema, such as 2 Gy x 39, 7.25 Gy x 5, or conventional/hypofractionated/SBRT.

overall_treatment_time_days.descr: Planned or actual overall radiotherapy course duration in days.

session_number.descr: Radiotherapy session number within the course, if the record represents an individual treatment event; use 1..N.

session_date.descr: Date of the treatment session or attendance event.

session_attended.descr: Whether the patient attended and received the planned treatment session.

session_interrupted.descr: Whether the session was interrupted, delayed, or incomplete.

session_delay_minutes.descr: Delay from scheduled start to actual delivery in minutes, if available.

delivered_dose_gy.descr: Dose actually delivered during this session in Gray.

cumulative_delivered_dose_gy.descr: Running cumulative delivered dose in Gray up to this session.

image_guidance_used.descr: Whether image guidance was used for treatment setup, such as IGRT or CBCT.

adverse_event_present.descr: Whether any treatment-related adverse event was recorded during this session or follow-up interval.

adverse_event_type.descr: Primary adverse event category, such as urinary, gastrointestinal, sexual, fatigue, dermatologic, hematologic, or other.

adverse_event_grade.descr: Severity grade using a standard toxicity scale such as CTCAE or RTOG; typically numeric grade values.

adverse_event_onset_date.descr: Date when the adverse event was first observed or reported.

adverse_event_resolved.descr: Whether the adverse event has resolved by last follow-up.

adverse_event_relatedness.descr: Assessed relationship of the adverse event to radiotherapy, such as unrelated, possibly related, probably related, definitely related.

follow_up_time_months.descr: Time from radiotherapy start or completion to follow-up in months; specify the reference time in registry documentation.

disease_status.descr: Disease status at follow-up, such as no evidence of disease, stable disease, progression, biochemical recurrence, metastatic progression, deceased.

biochemical_recurrence.descr: Whether biochemical recurrence has occurred by this follow-up.

local_recurrence.descr: Whether local recurrence has occurred by this follow-up.

metastatic_recurrence.descr: Whether metastatic recurrence has occurred by this follow-up.

overall_survival_status.descr: Vital status at follow-up, such as alive, dead, lost to follow-up, unknown.

cause_of_death.descr: Recorded cause of death, if known; example values include prostate cancer, treatment complication, cardiovascular, other, unknown.

progression_free_survival_event.descr: Whether a progression-free survival event has occurred.

quality_of_life_instrument.descr: Name of the quality-of-life instrument used, such as EPIC, EORTC QLQ-C30, EORTC PR25, FACT-P, or other.

quality_of_life_score.descr: Quality-of-life score from the selected instrument, as recorded at follow-up.

quality_of_life_domain.descr: Specific domain scored, such as urinary, bowel, sexual, hormonal, global health, or overall summary.

androgen_deprivation_therapy_during_rt.descr: Whether androgen deprivation therapy was administered concurrently with radiotherapy.

androgen_deprivation_duration_months.descr: Duration of androgen deprivation therapy in months, if applicable.

boost_treated.descr: Whether a boost field or boost phase was included in the treatment plan.

pelvic_nodes_treated.descr: Whether pelvic lymph nodes were included in the treated volume.

organs_at_risk_constraint_met.descr: Whether key organ-at-risk constraints were met according to the treatment plan evaluation.

rectal_dose_constraint.descr: Recorded rectal dose constraint value or summary used in planning, if available.

bladder_dose_constraint.descr: Recorded bladder dose constraint value or summary used in planning, if available.

planner_notes.descr: Optional brief structured notes on planning deviations, protocol amendments, or exceptional circumstances.
